items.title: Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
items.summary: The departure of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is reportedly creating significant uncertainty and a funding gap for AI startups, according to venture capitalists and founders.

items.title: SO-Arena: Benchmarking the Capability Spectrum and Reliability of System One Models
items.summary: A new benchmark, SO-Arena, is introduced to evaluate the capabilities and reliability of 'System One' AI models, which are designed for rapid, intuitive responses.

items.title: AI agent startup LangChain hits $3B valuation
items.summary: AI agent development platform LangChain has achieved a significant milestone, reaching a $3 billion valuation in its latest funding round.

items.title: Export-banned Nvidia chips are behind China’s most powerful AI models — uh-oh, Jensen!
items.summary: Reports indicate that export-restricted Nvidia chips are still being utilized to power China's most advanced AI models, raising concerns about trade regulations.

items.title: Introducing ChatGPT Wallet
items.summary: OpenAI has launched ChatGPT Wallet, a new feature designed to integrate financial transactions and services directly within the ChatGPT platform.

items.title: PhysLoop: Harnessing LLMs' Physics Awareness for Self-Improving Video Generation Models
items.summary: Researchers propose PhysLoop, a method that leverages Large Language Models' understanding of physics to enable self-improvement in video generation models.

items.title: Congrats to the Hacktoberfest Open-Source AI Challenge Week 4: Ghost in the Machine Winners!
items.summary: The winners of the Hacktoberfest Open-Source AI Challenge Week 4, focusing on 'Ghost in the Machine' themes, have been announced, celebrating community contributions to open-source AI.

items.title: G-STAR: Group-Scaled Token Capacity for Deeply Compressed Autoregressive Generation
items.summary: A new technique called G-STAR is introduced to achieve deeply compressed autoregressive generation by efficiently scaling token capacity.

items.title: Open Vision Banana: A Fully Open Recipe for Generative Visual Perception
items.summary: Open Vision Banana presents a comprehensive and open-source framework for generative visual perception, offering a new recipe for the community.

items.title: Actor, Judge, or Teacher? Understanding Decision Models in Long-Horizon Agents
items.summary: This research explores the different roles and decision-making processes within long-horizon AI agents, categorizing them as actors, judges, or teachers.

items.title: remove.bg Is Shutting Down — Here's a Free, No-Upload Alternative
items.summary: The popular image background removal service remove.bg is shutting down, prompting the community to share free, privacy-focused alternatives that don't require uploading images.

items.title: Ropedia Xperience 2: A Gold Standard for Scaling Physical AI Environments and Behaviors
items.summary: Ropedia Xperience 2 is introduced as a new benchmark and environment for effectively scaling physical AI simulations and complex agent behaviors.

items.title: On the Design of Hyper-Connections: Simplification, Stability, and Scalability
items.summary: A new paper investigates the fundamental design principles of hyper-connections in neural networks, focusing on simplification, stability, and scalability.

items.title: TTB: Test-time Baking for Efficient Rendering of Decoder-only View Synthesis Models
items.summary: TTB (Test-time Baking) is proposed as an efficient rendering technique for decoder-only view synthesis models, improving performance during inference.

items.title: Can't Beat Free: Gemma 4 31B on AMD Token Lab, with a Local Chat Page and an ADK Agent
items.summary: A guide demonstrates how to run the Gemma 4 31B model on AMD Token Lab for free, including setting up a local chat interface and an ADK agent.
